name: Agrippina the Younger
contribution: Roman empress from AD 49 to 54, the fourth wife and niece of emperor Claudius, and the mother of Nero.

checks.lead: Julia Agrippina (6 November AD 15 – 23 March AD 59), also referred to as Agrippina the Younger, was Roman empress from AD 49 to 54, the fourth wife and niece of emperor Claudius, and the mother of Nero.
